summary: The filing is a preliminary prospectus supplement filed by Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria, S.A. (BBVA) under Rule 424(b)(5), registering an offering of senior non-preferred fixed and floating rate notes due 2029 and later years. This is a routine debt issuance by a financial institution, not a special situation. The notes are direct, unsecured, ordinary claims ranking junior to privileged claims and senior preferred obligations, but senior to subordinated obligations under Spanish insolvency law. The offering terms (principal amounts, interest rates) are left blank in this preliminary version. There is no merger, acquisition, restructuring, or other special-situation element. The filing is purely a capital markets transaction.
